title: Help & Contribute
intro: Want to help improve DLNS Stats? Pick a task that fits your time and skill level.

banner.title: Want to help the project?
banner.message: We are looking for people who can help improve DLNS Stats with data cleanup, UI polish, and documentation.
details: Documentation, bug fixes, and feature ideas

sections.title: Small Contributions
sections.body: Found a bug, typo, or small UI issue? These are the easiest places to start.

sections.title: Major Contributions
sections.body: Have bigger ideas or want to collaborate regularly? We can use help with larger features.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.body: A practical path to jump in and make a change.
steps: Install dependencies with pip install -r requirements.txt

support.title: Other Ways to Help
support.body: Not a developer? You can still help by supporting the project, sharing it, or sending feedback. You can also subscribe to the DLNS patreon to support them!
